title: Night Cream for Sensitive Skin: How to Choose and Start Safely
ex: Sensitive skin needs a gentle cream and a slow start. Here is what to look for, how to patch test and how to introduce a new night cream.
rt: Night Cream for Sensitive Skin: Start Safely | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for sensitive skin: what ingredients to look for, how to patch test, a slow three-week start and the signs that mean you should stop using it.
quick: Choose a cream with a short ingredient list, little or no strong fragrance and soothing ingredients such as aloe vera. Patch test for three nights, then start every second or third night and build up slowly over two to three weeks, changing nothing else in your routine.
facts: Patch test behind the ear for three nights
Start every second or third night
Introduce only one new product at a time
Use sunscreen every morning with kojic acid creams
